name: Input
label: Input
description: Text input with label, placeholder, icons, a prefix or suffix, a clear button, helper text, and error states.

props.name: type
props.description: Input type — curated subset; use a dedicated component for checkbox/radio/file

props.name: size
props.description: Component size (not the native character-width `size` attribute)

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — shows error styling and message

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text displayed below the input. With the older `error` flag and no `errorText`, it doubles as the error message.

props.name: errorText
props.description: The error message, shown under the input while the helper text keeps its place. Setting it marks the input invalid; Field's spec owns the wiring.

props.name: prefix
props.description:
Text or a node inside the field before the value, read by a screen reader
as part of the field (a currency symbol, `https://`, a country code). Not
the decorative `iconLeft`. Note: this shadows the native `prefix`
attribute (an RDFa vocabulary), which Input does not expose.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text or a node inside the field after the value, read by a screen reader as part of the field (a unit, `.com`, `%`). Not the decorative `iconRight`.

props.name: action
props.description: A control inside the field at its end, after the suffix: a show/hide button, a copy button. Unlike `suffix` it is not read as part of the field; it is a control of its own.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show a clear button while the field holds a value. It empties the field, fires `onChange` and `onValueChange` with an empty value, then `onClear`, and returns focus to the field.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button. Defaults to "Clear".

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button empties the field.

props.name: iconLeft
props.description: Leading icon — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode)

props.name: iconRight
props.description: Trailing icon — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode)

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Convenience callback receiving the value directly.
Fires alongside `onChange`, which keeps the standard React event signature
so form libraries (react-hook-form, Formik, TanStack Form) work unmodified.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes — applied to the wrapper, not the <input>
